summary: Make TinyDB update/remove/insert_multiple atomic on all storages (including MemoryStorage) and invalidate the query cache on write failures so searches always reflect stored data.

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.then: KeyError is raised and db.all() returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}] (unchanged)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with JSONStorage (temp file) containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.then: KeyError is raised, the file content is unchanged, and db.all() returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a'}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.when: db.insert_multiple([{'name': 'c'}, {'invalid': 'doc'}]) raises an exception (e.g. validation error in user code)
acceptance_criteria.then: the exception propagates and db.all() returns [{'name': 'a'}, {'name': 'b'}] (unchanged)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}] and a prior search db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) that returned [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}]
acceptance_criteria.then: a subsequent db.search(Query().tmp.exists()) returns [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}] (cache invalidated, matches stored data)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a'}]
acceptance_criteria.then: db.all() returns [] and a subsequent db.search(Query().name == 'a') returns [] (cache invalidated on successful write)

acceptance_criteria.given: a TinyDB instance with MemoryStorage containing [{'name': 'a', 'tmp': 1}, {'name': 'b'}]
acceptance_criteria.then: the raised exception is KeyError with message "'tmp'"

acceptance_criteria.when: importing TinyDB, MemoryStorage, JSONStorage, CachingMiddleware and calling their public methods
acceptance_criteria.then: no AttributeError, TypeError or signature change occurs; all existing public classes and methods are present

assumptions.assumption: Atomicity applies to all exceptions inheriting from Exception raised during the write operation; KeyboardInterrupt and MemoryError are not caught.
assumptions.default_used: Catch Exception in the write path.

assumptions.assumption: Only the core TinyDB query cache (cleared by clear_cache()) must be invalidated on failed writes; CachingMiddleware and other middlewares manage their own caches.
Atomicity is achieved by preparing the new data in memory and calling storage.write once on success; the Storage interface does not change.
assumptions.default_used: In-memory copy → modify → single write on success.
